text: 周五（8月28日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率涨2.6个基点，报3.279%，美联储主席沃什在北京时间22:00披露的杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会讲稿中释放鹰派基调，收益率短线转跌，22:44前后再度转跌，本周累计上涨2.0个基点，整体呈现出V形反转。 两年期德债收益率涨4.2个基点，报2.906%，沃什讲稿披露后显著扩大涨幅，本周累涨5.8个基点，8月26日欧股开盘之前跌至2.784%，随后持续走高；30年期德债收益率涨1.3个基点，报3.768%。 2/10年期德债收益率利差跌1.697个基点，报+36.990个基点，本周累涨0.006个基点。
text_en: In late European trading on Friday (August 28), the yield on Germany's 10-year Bund rose 2.6 basis points to 3.279%. After Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish tone in his Jackson Hole speech released at 22:00 Beijing time, yields briefly turned lower, then fell again around 22:44, ending the week up 2.0 basis points with a V-shaped reversal overall. The 2-year Bund yield rose 4.2 basis points to 2.906%, expanding gains notably after Warsh's speech, up 5.8 basis points on the week, having dipped to 2.784% before European markets opened on August 26 before trending higher; the 30-year Bund yield rose 1.3 basis points to 3.768%. The 2/10-year Bund yield spread fell 1.697 basis points to +36.990 basis points, up 0.006 basis point on the week.
